MD001.comment: Heading levels should only increment by one level at a time

MD003.comment: Heading style must be consistent (ATX style)

MD004.comment: Unordered list style must be consistent

MD012.comment: Multiple consecutive blank lines not allowed

MD013.comment: Line length limit disabled for code examples and long URLs

MD014.comment: Dollar signs used before commands without showing output not allowed

MD022.comment: Headings should be surrounded by blank lines

MD023.comment: Headings must start at the beginning of the line

MD024.comment: Multiple headings with the same content allowed (common in skills)

MD026.comment: Trailing punctuation in heading not allowed

MD027.comment: Multiple spaces after blockquote symbol not allowed

MD028.comment: Blank line inside blockquote not allowed

MD029.comment: Ordered list item prefix style must be consistent

MD031.comment: Fenced code blocks should be surrounded by blank lines

MD032.comment: Lists should be surrounded by blank lines

MD033.comment: Inline HTML allowed for complex tables and formatting

MD034.comment: Bare URLs should be enclosed in angle brackets

MD035.comment: Horizontal rule style must be consistent

MD036.comment: Emphasis used instead of a heading not allowed

MD037.comment: Spaces inside emphasis markers not allowed

MD038.comment: Spaces inside code span elements not allowed

MD039.comment: Spaces inside link text not allowed

MD040.comment: Fenced code blocks MUST have a language specified (CRITICAL FOR SKILLS)

MD041.comment: First line in file should be a top-level heading (after frontmatter)

MD044.comment: Proper names should have the correct capitalization

MD045.comment: Images should have alternate text (alt text)

MD046.comment: Code block style must be consistent (fenced)

MD047.comment: Files should end with a single newline character

MD048.comment: Code fence style must be consistent (backtick)

MD052.comment: Reference links and images should use a label that is defined

MD053.comment: Link and image reference definitions should be needed

frontMatter.comment: YAML frontmatter is allowed and expected in skills

custom-rules.description: Skills must have valid YAML frontmatter with required fields
Skills must have all five required sections

config.purpose: Enforce CFN skill markdown format specification
